entry.idea: Every team building an AI app ends up building its own system to store and retrieve context, like memory and documents, so Twigg gives them a ready-made context layer to plug in instead.
entry.lesson: When many teams are rebuilding the same piece of plumbing by hand, package it as a reusable product.
entry.name: Twigg

growth.reason: The product just launched with no user, revenue, or other numbers available.

market.reason: Every team building AI apps needs a context or memory layer, a real and growing but still specialized market.

tech.reason: Context and memory layers for AI apps are a known idea with several existing competitors, so a strong team could match this in months.

sources.title: Introducing Twigg: A Visual AI Context Management Tool

entry.twist: It is built to be visual, so developers can see and manage what context their AI has, rather than only calling an API blind.
entry.who_pays: Developers and companies building AI apps who would otherwise spend time building this infrastructure themselves.
entry.why_now: As more companies build AI apps, most run into the same need for a context and memory layer, creating demand for an off-the-shelf tool instead of everyone building their own.
